userHelp: Old downloaded PDFs, saved HTML, printed pattern sheets or catalogues with original URLs/dates/credits, particularly Haabet, JulehjerteDesign and Permo.

Introductions to designers or their families to confirm authorship/history and obtain explicit archival republication permission. Jan Krümmel and PaperMatrix’s Lene and Anna Schepper have primary collections represented here.
A durable off-laptop storage location for original asset bytes; checksums/manifests alone do not preserve images or templates.
